result_text:
The booking wizard now passes an axe WCAG 2 A/AA run with zero violations in every state I could reach, and `pnpm build` succeeds. The only change is in `src/app/[slug]/wizard.tsx`, left uncommitted.

- **Labels:** The date picker, name, and phone fields now have visible `<label>`s, with IDs from `useId`. The placeholders stay.
- **Contrast:** The grey durations and "Loading…" moved from `zinc-400` to `zinc-600`, which passes contrast on white.
- **Errors:** The "That time was just taken", "Check the name and phone…", and waitlist error messages now have `role="alert"`. The waitlist "joined" confirmation has `role="status"`.
- **Selection:** Service and staff buttons expose `aria-pressed`, and the selected one also gets a visible ✓. The ✓ is additive, so nothing sighted users see today is removed.

I checked this with a temporary harness page under `next dev`, with the API mocked in the browser and axe-core run at each state. The original wizard had 1–2 violations in almost every state; the updated one has none. I then deleted the harness.

The audit doesn't cover focus. After picking a time, the button that had focus is removed, so keyboard and screen reader users land on `<body>`. Moving focus to the "Your details" heading would fix that; I left it out to keep this change to the four items in the issue.
